description.value: This McDonald's, known locally as the Golden Ears location, sits on Dewdney Trunk Road in Maple Ridge and serves the gateway community to Golden Ears Provincial Park. It offers a 24/7 drive-through alongside dine-in and curbside pickup options. For touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley, it is a familiar and reliable stop for hot food, beverages, and a rest.
